Per the rule, a general program at a generalist firm does not count unless tied to the sustainable-investing arm; kept as program-page/reference only since no qualifying dedicated posting was found. Note: US Summer 2027 IB cycle reportedly already closed (opened Dec 2025-Jan 2026, filled by May 2026).

internships.program: Macquarie Asset Management Summer Internship Program (Green Investments capability)
internships.notes: Macquarie Asset Management's internship program spans green investments, natural assets, infrastructure and other capabilities - the Green Investment Group (GIG) is Macquarie's dedicated green-infrastructure principal-investment arm. A 2027 MAM Summer Internship Program posting was found live on the Wall Street Friends job board. Could not independently confirm GIG-specific (vs. general MAM) placement guarantee, so marked program-page.
